text:
vikram: quick idea — can we split client-visible 429 into `429.throttle` vs `429.queueing`? getting a lot of ambiguous retries from customers.

sasha: curious — are you proposing new HTTP codes or just a header/enum in the body?

vikram: not new HTTP semantics, just consistent client-visible "status" field + headers. e.g.
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Redwood-Status: queueing
Retry-After: 3
{"error":"rate_limit","status":"queueing","retry_hint":"short_backoff"}
```

elaine: +1 for header. console needs a single badge (green/yellow/red) but also the metadata. For telemetry, we'd map `queueing`->"degraded_latency" and `throttle`->"hard_reject".

jordan: SDK impact — if X-Redwood-Status=queueing, SDK should do exponential backoff but not mark operation as failed in error-rate metrics. If throttle => fail-fast and surface to users.

sasha: concern: some clients rely on status codes only. We should default to 429 with `Retry-After` for both; header indicates nuance. SDKs then can implement two behaviors.

vikram: rollout plan: add header + body status to hosted API, start with console flag `show_queueing=false` turned on for canary tenants. Add telemetry label `client_status_bucket` with values {ok, queueing, throttle, degraded_timeout}.

elaine: console UX suggestion: show "degraded (queueing)" and link to runbook. Also add a microcopy: "We are operating at high throughput; requests may be queued — consider switching to dedicated or try again."

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC — canary to 1% then 10%.

jordan: question on metrics: do we treat queueing responses as SLO failures? my vote: count toward latency SLO, not error SLO.

sasha: agree. we'll add two counters: `response.client_status{bucket}` and `slo.error{is_error}` where queueing -> is_error=false, throttle->is_error=true.

vikram: ok I'll write a short RFC doc. next: should we add a 4xx subcode in the JSON body like `code: 429.1`? maybe overkill.

elaine: prefer simple strings in header/body. avoid numeric subcodes.

vikram: cool. i'll open a PR for header + telemetry mapping. tagging @sasha @jordan for review. :thumbsup:
